small_visual_text.where: Figure axes and legends; difficult to read at a distance, which may hinder understanding of the data.

dense_text.where: Abstract and Method sections; long paragraphs make scanning difficult.

layout.reason: The layout is well-structured with clear section separation and efficient use of the canvas, but the dense text in some sections slightly affects the flow.

readability.reason: Text in some sections is dense and difficult to scan, and figure axes and legends are too small to read clearly at a distance.

fidelity.reason: The poster accurately emphasizes the main findings of the paper, with relevant figures and captions supporting the conclusions.

holistic.reason: The poster communicates the main findings effectively with a clear layout and faithful representation of the source material. However, dense text and small figure text reduce overall readability.
